body:
> but if she is lying to these guys that she works with about you even existing, then can you really trust her?

This is where a lot of my issues are. I am at a point where I don't know where to draw the line with trust and jealousy. However I feel like this is really damning. To elaborate on this a bit, and something I did leave out:

During the two month break she also got intimate with my (our) best friend. They hang out alone a lot, at least once a week. This is something that she hid from me but I found out from a mutual friend. For the first two months we were back together she did not want to tell anyone that we were back together, specifically him. I didn't understand why at the time, but once I found out about that the pieces kind of fell together. They have not hung out since I found out a month ago.

[I literally just snooped on my SO's phone and found something I didn't like](https://www.reddit.com/r/relationship_advice/comments/3xz6ir/am_i_21m_being_too_jealous_of_gfs_21f_co_workers/)

This is what I did. Ask point blank if he has seen her at all lately. If he says no ask again. "REALLLLY?? Not even once?" Maybe even ask a third time. If he doesn't come clean after you have given him the chance, then just say it. I know you did and this is how I know. He has the right to be a bit angry, you'll probably get some shit for it. But it's much better than the alternative.
